_comment: Static fences for a two-speed delivery loop: BUILD fast, HARDEN once per feature.
safety: blocks always. A failure would reach production or a customer: tenancy, auth, secrets,
migrations, money, the deploy and CI path, or a broken or wrong product behaviour.
process: advisory while a feature is in build. It blocks in the hardening pass (the PR labelled harden).
Naming, docs, registries, wording, the look, lockstep and parity bookkeeping.
A new fence goes in ONE list, in the PR that adds it. If unsure, choose safety.
Entries are test file paths (or test ids) that your CI runner understands.
Wire it: CI runs every file in the safety list on each PR. It runs the process list too, but marks
a failure as a warning unless the PR is labelled harden. Add a test that every fence file is in
exactly one list, so a new fence cannot sit in neither.
